headline: DeepSeek's v4.1-flash hits 12.2% — day 2 at the summit
summary: DeepSeek's newest model just claimed the all-time token-share record at 12.2%, holding rank 1 for a second consecutive day. The top four providers (DeepSeek, Zhipu AI, Tencent, OpenAI) now command 62.9% of the market. OpenAI's fresh gpt-6-astra entry jumped 9 spots in a single day, while Anthropic's claude-4.8-opus vaulted 14 ranks to crack the top 30.
highlights: deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20260910 sets all-time record: 12.2% token share, day 2 at rank 1
openai/gpt-6-astra-20260903 debuts at rank 19 after a 9-rank jump in one day
DeepSeek, Zhipu AI, Tencent, and OpenAI hold 62.9% combined
